title: DefinitionMode
description: How much Lewis & Short sense material to return for Latin → English lookups. Morphology and connections tabs are always included when present in the source entry.

definition_mode.description: both (default, Logeion-style): include brief_glosses and the full definitions tree. brief: only brief_glosses (plus tabs). full: only the long definitions tree (Scriba-style main reading tab).
